Using advanced digital techniques, we will enhance the details and textures, ensuring that the final product not only looks authentic but also resonates with viewers. This service is ideal for individuals looking to revitalize family heirlooms, historical images, or any cherished memories that deserve a fresh perspective. The final colorized images will be delivered in high-resolution formats suitable for both print and digital use, allowing clients to share and preserve their memories for future generations.
deliverables: Colorized version of the original black-and-white photo (work)
High-resolution digital files in JPEG and PNG formats (document)
Color palette reference for each image (document)
Revisions based on client feedback (work)
